content.subtitle: Network Time Protocol — synchronise system time with upstream servers
content.emptyHint: Add at least one upstream NTP server to synchronise time

leapSecond.defaultDesc: Use UTC timezone database (VyOS default behaviour)
leapSecond.timezoneDesc: Explicitly set: use UTC timezone database to determine leap second
leapSecond.ignoreDesc: No correction is applied to the clock
leapSecond.smearDesc: Correct time gradually by slewing instead of stepping
leapSecond.systemDesc: Kernel steps the system clock forward or backward

delete.title: Remove NTP Server
delete.description: Remove server <mono>{name}</mono> from the NTP configuration? This cannot be undone.

server.nameRequired: Server hostname or IP address is required
server.editDescription: Update flags for this NTP server
server.addDescription: Add an upstream NTP server to synchronise time from
server.nameHint: Hostname, IPv4, or IPv6 address of the NTP server
server.poolHint: Treat as an NTP pool — resolves to multiple servers behind one hostname
server.preferHint: Mark as the preferred time source; used first when available
server.ntsHint: Enable Network Time Security — authenticates time data cryptographically
server.noSelectHint: Monitor only — server is queried but never used for synchronisation

settings.receiveFiltersHint: Select which inbound packets each NIC hardware-timestamps. This device supports it.
settings.title: Edit NTP Settings
settings.description: Configure listen addresses, client restrictions, and global NTP behaviour
settings.listenAddressesHint: Local IP addresses to bind the NTP service to. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.
settings.invalidAddress: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
settings.allowClientsHint: Restrict NTP service to specific client addresses or subnets. Leave empty to allow all clients.
settings.invalidAddressOrCidr: Enter a valid IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR
settings.interfacesHint: Listen for NTP on specific network interfaces only. Leave empty for all interfaces.
settings.leapSecondHint: How the system clock behaves when a leap second is inserted
settings.vrfHint: Bind the NTP service to a specific VRF. Leave empty to use the default routing table.
